reports.title: Hydrocarbon production was 2,474 thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day in the third quarter of 2026, up more than 3% compared to the second quarter, benefiting from a gradual return-to-normal oil production in the Middle East.

lines: With the evolution of oil and gas prices in recent months and the lag effect on pricing formulas, TotalEnergies anticipates an increasing average LNG selling price of above $14/Mbtu for the fourth quarter of 2026.
Excluding the impact of the conflict in the Middle East, fourth-quarter production is expected to grow by more than 3% compared to fourth quarter 2025, in line with the annual growth guidance.
The Company confirms its planned investments for the year, for a net amount of around $15 billion over 2026, in line with the annual guidance.

This increase is in line with the shareholder returns policy approved by the Board of Directors and announced during the Strategy and Outlook Presentation in New York on September 28, 2026, which provides for annual dividend growth of more than 5% through 2030, in line with the Company’s expected cash flow growth.
